title: FMC gets FeRAM cash to kill Optane's ghost

title: Dallas DS1230Y DS1235YW NVRAM FRAM Replacement Adapter
supports: Open-source adapter puts a Ramtron/Cypress FM18W08 F-RAM in place of DS1230Y/DS1235YW battery-backed NVSRAM; sealed lithium cells fail after ~10-15 years (via search snippet)

title: The optimal solution to eliminate batteries for SRAM in industrial machinery
